name: Cryo Nation
worldConcept: Cryo Nation is a sealed colony struggling to survive inside a protective cloche on a hostile world. The settlers believe they are pioneers, but they are repeating a cycle shaped by two ancient terraforming AIs that have been failing for longer than anyone knows. Their broken, competing attempts to remake the planet twist the environment into shifting patterns of danger and opportunity. The colonists were never meant to be here; they were delivered into this cycle by A.N.G.E.L., the ship’s guidance AI, whose final act was to abandon its original mission and hand them over to a world locked in endless, failing creation.
